name: Усунення захисника: зв’язка (1)
description:
Two ways you have learned so far to eliminate a defender are: capturing and deflecting. In the coming lessons, we will capture a the defender as a preparatory move for a pin. See example 1.

What do you have to do?

Capture the defender and then gain material thanks to a pin.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rf8,Rg8][%cal Gb5e8] [#]} 1. Nxb5 $1 (1. Re8?   Bxe8) 1... axb5 2. Re8 *
examples.text:
The black queen and king are on the same line (rank). However, pinning with 1.Re8 does not work yet, because the bishop on b5 defends this square. So White has to eliminate this defender first!

1.Nxb5! axb5 (if Black doesn't recapture, White has simply won a piece and Re8 comes on the next move anyway). Now white pins the queen succesfully with 2.Re8.

texts: The white bishop is a key defender.
